OPPORTUNITIES

JOIN OUR LAB

We are actively looking for creative, enthusiastic graduate students and undergraduate researchers to join our team. If you are interested in electrochemical energy conversion, electrocatalysts, or water electrolysis, please contact Prof. Soo-Kil Kim with your CV and academic transcripts.
